title.zh-CN: 持续黄疸伴淡色便 · 2月龄男婴
title.en: Persistent jaundice and pale stools · 2-month-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 2月龄男婴自生后第3天起出现黄疸并逐渐加深，此前住院用药一周黄疸未见好转。由家属陪同收入儿科病房，需要查明原因并决定下一步。
summary.en: A two-month-old boy has been jaundiced since his third day of life, the yellow gradually deepening; a week of medicine during an earlier admission did not improve it. He is admitted to the children's ward with a relative to find the cause and decide what comes next.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：黄疸起病和经过、大小便颜色、喂养、此前住院用药、出生史、发育、家族史、乙肝疫苗、入院查体、胆红素/GGT/白蛋白/PT/APTT、血氨/瓜氨酸/甲胎蛋白、超声和MRCP、SLC25A13家系结果、营养治疗后的变化、再次入院腹腔镜和活检所见、家属未接受Kasai手术；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除。陪同家属的具体身份、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；首批结果放在入院阶段、基因结果和病程记录放在第三阶段，是教学上的分阶段安排。没有记录的内容（生命体征、转氨酶、出生后维生素K、上次住院用药、营养方案、腹腔镜时月龄、长期结局）保持未知。保留的不一致：分诊记录写“吃奶精神尚可”，病史写“精神食欲正常”；结论称胆道闭锁“经手术病理证实”，转归记录写“活检支持”；未知项提到“HBsAg后续核实”，但没有写明是谁的结果。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: onset and course of the jaundice, urine and stool colour, feeding, the earlier admission and its week of medicine, birth, development, family history, hepatitis B vaccination, the admission examination, bilirubin/GGT/albumin/PT/APTT, ammonia/citrulline/AFP, ultrasound and MRCP, the SLC25A13 family result, the change after nutritional treatment, the laparoscopy and biopsy on a later readmission and the family's decision not to accept a Kasai operation; they have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed. Which relative accompanies him, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; showing the first results on admission and the genetic result with the progress note in the third phase is staging for teaching. What the case does not record (vital signs, transaminases, vitamin K after birth, the earlier medicines, the nutritional regimen, his age at laparoscopy, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. Inconsistencies kept: the triage note says feeding and alertness were 'fair' (尚可) while the history says 'normal'; the conclusion calls the atresia 'confirmed at operation and on histology' while the outcome record says the biopsy 'supported' it; the unknowns name 'follow-up of HBsAg positivity' without saying whose result it is.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例的教学回看，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和检查结果来自已发表的报告，不模拟没有记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: A historical case for clinical teaching, not for individual care or self-treatment. The course and results come from a published report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在2月龄的黄疸婴儿中识别结合胆红素升高（直接胆红素>17 μmol/L即为病理性，NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017），把它当作需要当天评估胆道闭锁的胆汁淤积，而不因大便“只是淡黄”、吃奶好就放松。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia in a jaundiced 2-month-old (direct bilirubin above 17 µmol/L is pathological; NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017) and treat it as cholestasis needing same-day evaluation for biliary atresia, however pale-yellow rather than white the stools and however well he feeds.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 胆汁淤积婴儿PT、APTT延长时，先按维生素K缺乏处理：立即注射维生素K（1 mg静脉注射，Konakion MM Paediatric说明书2024年版），在任何活检或手术前复查凝血。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat a prolonged PT and APTT in a cholestatic infant as vitamin K deficiency until shown otherwise: give vitamin K by injection at once (1 mg IV; Konakion MM Paediatric SmPC, 2024) and recheck the clotting before any biopsy or operation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把瓜氨酸和血氨升高、甲胎蛋白451055 ng/mL解读为指向citrin缺陷（由SLC25A13检测确认），同时说明为什么MRCP上看不到肝外胆管仍然需要胆道造影——两种病可以并存。
learningOutcomes.en: Read raised citrulline and ammonia with an AFP of 451055 ng/mL as pointing to citrin deficiency (confirmed by SLC25A13 testing) while explaining why extrahepatic ducts that MRCP cannot show still demand cholangiography — the two diseases can coexist.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么复合杂合的SLC25A13结果和无乳糖、富含MCT配方奶带来的代谢改善（Inui等，2024）不能解释持续的胆汁淤积，并且不等基因结果就安排腹腔镜或开腹胆道造影（国家卫健委2025年版：不能排除胆道闭锁时生后45天内行胆道造影；Kasai手术45天内最佳，超过90天效果不佳）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why a compound heterozygous SLC25A13 result and a metabolic response to a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula (Inui et al., 2024) do not explain persistent cholestasis, and arrange laparoscopic or open cholangiography without waiting for the gene result (NHC 2025: cholangiography within 45 days of life when atresia cannot be excluded; Kasai best within 45 days, poor after 90).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免对这个婴儿看似合理却有害的做法：光疗退黄、按尿素循环障碍停奶并输高浓度葡萄糖、凝血未纠正就在病房肝穿刺、出院等待。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid the plausible but harmful steps for this infant: phototherapy, a urea-cycle regimen that stops milk and runs high-concentration glucose, a ward liver biopsy before the clotting is corrected, and discharge to wait.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES和回授法与家属讨论胆道造影和可能的Kasai手术（随日龄下降的获益、风险、以后可能需要肝移植），并说明citrin缺陷的常染色体隐性遗传（每次怀孕1/4的机会）。
learningOutcomes.en: Counsel the family with SPIKES and teach-back about cholangiography and a possible Kasai operation — a benefit that falls with age, the risks, a transplant that may still be needed — and about the autosomal recessive inheritance of citrin deficiency (a 1 in 4 chance in each pregnancy).

triageNote.en: Boy aged two months. Yellow since his third day of life and gradually deepening, with yellow urine and pale-yellow stools; feeding and alertness fair. Admitted at about six weeks and given a week of medicine without improvement. Admitted to the children's ward today with a relative.

concerns.zh-CN: 他黄了这么久，到底是什么原因？

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者注意：婴儿不说话；入院时皮肤和眼白发黄、反应好。家属回答所有问题，着急但配合，只说自己知道的事：黄疸从生后第3天开始、越来越黄，小便黄，大便淡黄色、从没见过白陶土样，精神和胃口正常，母乳加奶粉、没加辅食，一个半月时住院用药一周没有好转，足月顺产2.9公斤，会笑，爸爸乙肝阳性，妈妈和姐姐健康，没听说家里有遗传病，打过乙肝疫苗。化验结果和诊断由医生说；不知道的事（上次用了什么药、做过什么检查、出生后是否打过维生素K、有没有出血、过敏、怀孕和新生儿筛查情况、父母是否近亲）就直说不知道，不要编。到第三阶段才说“治疗后还是黄”，并问为什么还要手术。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the baby does not talk; on admission his skin and the whites of his eyes are yellow and he responds well. The relative answers every question, worried but cooperative, saying only what they know: yellow from his third day and deepening, yellow urine, pale-yellow stools never seen white like clay, normal alertness and appetite, breast milk plus formula with no solids, a week of medicine during an admission at about six weeks without improvement, born at term by vaginal delivery weighing 2.9 kg, smiling now, his father hepatitis B positive, his mother and older sister healthy, no inherited illness known in the family, hepatitis B vaccine given. Results and the diagnosis are for the doctors; whatever they do not know (the earlier medicines and tests, vitamin K after birth, any bleeding, allergies, the pregnancy and newborn screening, whether the parents are related) they say so plainly and never invent. Only in the third phase do they say he is still yellow after treatment and ask why an operation is still needed.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属，陪他住院；病例没有写明是哪位亲属，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，但愿意配合；用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative staying with him in hospital; the case does not say which relative, so invent none. Worried and protective but cooperative; answers in everyday words, says only what they know or have heard from the doctors, and draws no medical conclusions.

dose.zh-CN: 维生素K1（植物甲萘醌）1 mg 静脉注射；之后根据临床情况和凝血结果决定是否追加（Konakion MM Paediatric说明书，2024年修订）。胆汁淤积的婴儿口服吸收不可靠，必须注射给药；静脉注射后有类过敏反应的报道，给药时观察。
dose.en: Phytomenadione (vitamin K1) 1 mg IV, with further doses as the clinical picture and the clotting require (Konakion MM Paediatric SmPC, revised 2024). Oral vitamin K is poorly absorbed in a cholestatic infant, so it must be injected; anaphylactoid reactions after IV injection are reported, so watch him while it is given.

dose.zh-CN: 在营养师和遗传代谢科指导下改用无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶，同时补充脂溶性维生素（Inui等，亚太儿科胃肠肝病营养学会专家意见，2024；GeneReviews，2025年修订）。
dose.en: A lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula as the dietitian and the metabolic team advise, with fat-soluble vitamins (Inui et al., APPSPGHAN expert review, 2024; GeneReviews, revised 2025).

response.zh-CN: 已改用无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶。本病例只记录了“营养治疗”，没有写明用的是哪种奶粉或方案。
response.en: Feeds changed to a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula. This case records 'nutritional treatment' without naming the feed or regimen used.

name.en: Fat-soluble vitamin supplements (A, D, E, K)

dose.zh-CN: 按体重和胆汁淤积程度补充维生素A、D、E、K，并监测其水平（剂量按当地处方集）。
dose.en: Vitamins A, D, E and K by weight and the degree of cholestasis, with levels monitored (doses per the local formulary).

response.zh-CN: 已开始补充脂溶性维生素。本病例没有记录维生素补充。
response.en: Fat-soluble vitamins started. This case records no vitamin supplements.

dose.zh-CN: 请遗传代谢科就喂养、基因检测和需要避免的情况（如高浓度葡萄糖输注）给出意见。
dose.en: Ask the metabolic team to advise on feeds, the genetic test and what to avoid (such as high-concentration glucose infusions).

response.zh-CN: 遗传代谢科医生已知情，会来看他并就喂养和基因检测给出意见。本病例没有记录这次会诊。
response.en: The metabolic team has been told and will advise on feeds and the genetic test. This case does not record this consultation.

name.zh-CN: 亲自看一份新鲜大便，对照大便比色卡
name.en: Look at a fresh stool yourself against a stool colour card

dose.zh-CN: 请家属或护士留一份新鲜大便（尿布），在自然光下对照比色卡判断。
dose.en: Ask the relative or the nurse for a fresh stool (nappy) and compare it with the card in daylight.

response.zh-CN: 已查看。本病例没有记录医护人员对他大便颜色的描述或比色卡读数；家属描述为淡黄色、从未见过白陶土样。
response.en: Done. This case records no staff description or colour-card reading of his stool; his relative describes it as pale yellow and never clay-white.

name.zh-CN: 与家属正式谈话（上级医师和小儿外科医生参加）
name.en: Family meeting with the senior doctor and the paediatric surgeon

dose.zh-CN: 安排安静的房间和足够的时间：先了解家属已经知道什么、担心什么，再解释两种情况、胆道造影的必要性和时机、Kasai手术能做到和做不到的事，以及以后可能需要肝移植；请家属复述，并书面记录。
dose.en: A quiet room and enough time: ask what the family already know and fear, then explain the two conditions, why and how soon the cholangiogram is needed, what a Kasai operation can and cannot do, and that a transplant may be needed later; ask them to say it back, and write it down.

response.zh-CN: 已安排家属谈话。本病例没有记录当时与家属谈了什么。
response.en: The family meeting is arranged. This case does not record what the family were told.

name.zh-CN: 遗传咨询：常染色体隐性遗传与再生育风险
name.en: Genetic counselling: autosomal recessive inheritance and recurrence risk

dose.zh-CN: 向父母说明：两个变异分别来自父母，父母各携带一个变异；以后每次怀孕，孩子患病的机会为1/4；家庭成员检测和产前诊断可与遗传专科讨论。
dose.en: Explain to the parents that one variant came from each of them, so each carries one; each future pregnancy has a 1 in 4 chance of an affected child; testing of relatives and prenatal diagnosis can be discussed with the genetics team.

response.zh-CN: 已安排遗传咨询。本病例没有记录遗传咨询。
response.en: Genetic counselling is arranged. This case does not record genetic counselling.

dose.zh-CN: 蓝光照射，期间监测胆红素。
dose.en: Phototherapy under the lights, with bilirubin monitoring.

harm.zh-CN: 光疗只降低非结合胆红素。黄疸持续两个月、大便颜色变浅的婴儿要先按胆汁淤积评估：NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017指南规定直接胆红素>17 μmol/L即为病理性，需要进行诊断评估（推荐3）。对胆汁淤积的婴儿，光疗没有益处，还可能引起“青铜症”（皮肤灰褐色），更会拖延胆道闭锁的评估。
harm.en: Phototherapy lowers only unconjugated bilirubin. An infant jaundiced for two months with pale stools is assessed for cholestasis first: NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 holds a direct bilirubin above 17 µmol/L to be pathological and to warrant diagnostic evaluation (recommendation 3). In a cholestatic infant phototherapy brings no benefit, can cause bronze baby syndrome, and delays the evaluation for biliary atresia.

response.zh-CN: 已开始光疗。本病例没有记录光疗，也不模拟它的效果。
response.en: Phototherapy started. No phototherapy is recorded in this case, and its effect is not modelled.

name.zh-CN: 今天在病房做经皮肝穿刺活检
name.en: Percutaneous liver biopsy on the ward today

dose.zh-CN: 超声引导下经皮肝穿刺取组织。
dose.en: Ultrasound-guided percutaneous core biopsy of the liver.

harm.zh-CN: 胆汁淤积的婴儿常有维生素K缺乏，凝血没有确认纠正之前不能穿刺：即使由有经验的医生操作，NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017指南引用的一组婴儿肝活检中仍有4.6%（65例中3例）发生需要干预的出血，凝血异常时风险更高。应先注射维生素K并复查凝血。而且这个婴儿需要的确诊检查是胆道造影，肝活检可在造影时一并取得，单独再做一次穿刺只会增加风险、拖延手术。
harm.en: Cholestatic infants are often vitamin K deficient, and no needle goes in until the clotting is shown to be corrected: even in experienced hands, 4.6 % of infant liver biopsies (3 of 65) in a series NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 cites had bleeding that needed intervention, and abnormal clotting raises the risk. Vitamin K by injection and a repeat clotting screen come first. And the test he needs is cholangiography, where the biopsy can be taken at the same operation; a separate needle biopsy adds risk and delays it.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录经皮肝穿刺，也不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case records no percutaneous biopsy; the consequences are not modelled.

name.zh-CN: 出院回家，4周后门诊复查
name.en: Discharge home with a clinic review in four weeks

dose.zh-CN: 出院，4周后门诊复查胆红素。
dose.en: Home, with a bilirubin check in clinic in four weeks.

harm.zh-CN: 他已经2个月大，黄疸持续、大便颜色变浅，胆道闭锁必须尽快排除：NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017指出Kasai手术在生后60天内完成时约70%能恢复胆汁引流，90天后不到25%；国家卫健委《先天性胆道闭锁诊疗指南（2025版）》以生后45天内为最佳时机，超过90天效果不佳。再等4周可能让他失去保留自体肝的机会；胆汁淤积的婴儿在没有注射维生素K的情况下回家，还有出血的风险。
harm.en: At two months old, with persistent jaundice and pale stools, biliary atresia has to be excluded quickly: NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 reports bile flow restored in about 70 % of infants when the Kasai operation is done within 60 days of life and in fewer than 25 % after 90 days; the 2025 Chinese national guideline puts the best time within 45 days and the results after 90 days as poor. Four more weeks could cost him the chance to keep his own liver, and a cholestatic infant sent home without injected vitamin K is at risk of bleeding.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这样的出院安排，也不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case records no such discharge plan; the consequences are not modelled.

name.zh-CN: 按尿素循环障碍处理：停奶、禁蛋白，静脉输注高浓度葡萄糖
name.en: Treat as a urea-cycle disorder: stop milk and protein and run a high-concentration glucose infusion

dose.zh-CN: 停所有奶，静脉输注10%或更高浓度的葡萄糖。
dose.en: All milk stopped; IV glucose at 10 % or stronger.

harm.zh-CN: 吃奶好的胆汁淤积婴儿血氨升高，可能是citrin缺陷所致，而citrin缺陷不能按经典尿素循环障碍处理：GeneReviews（Song、Oishi和Saheki，2025年修订）把葡萄糖、甘油和果糖输注（有脑水肿风险）以及低蛋白、高碳水化合物饮食列为需要避免的情况，Okano等（2019）也指出应避免持续输注高浓度葡萄糖的静脉营养。停奶禁蛋白还会让本已胆汁淤积的婴儿营养不良。citrin缺陷婴儿的治疗是无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶和脂溶性维生素（Inui等，2024；GeneReviews，2025）。
harm.en: Raised ammonia in a cholestatic infant who is feeding well can come from citrin deficiency, which is not managed like a classic urea-cycle disorder: GeneReviews (Song, Oishi and Saheki, revised 2025) lists glucose, glycerol and fructose infusions (for the risk of brain oedema) and low-protein, high-carbohydrate diets among what to avoid, and Okano et al. 2019 warn against continuous high-glucose intravenous feeding. Stopping milk and protein also leaves a cholestatic infant malnourished. Infants with citrin deficiency are given a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula and fat-soluble vitamins (Inui et al., 2024; GeneReviews, 2025).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这种处理，也不模拟其后果。
response.en: No such regimen is recorded in this case; the consequences are not modelled.

title.en: Hear his story from his relative

hint.zh-CN: 他还不会说话，由家属回答：黄疸什么时候开始、后来怎样？大小便什么颜色？吃奶和精神如何？以前治过吗？出生和家里人的情况呢？
hint.en: He can't talk, so his relative answers: when did the jaundice start and how has it changed, what colour are his stools and urine, how is he feeding, what has been tried before, and what about his birth and his family?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁向陪同的家属了解病史。
guidance.en: Take the history from his relative at the cot side.

hint.zh-CN: 皮肤和眼白、反应、体重、腹部都看了吗？肝脾摸了吗？
hint.en: Have you looked at his skin and eyes, how he responds, his weight and his abdomen — and felt his liver and spleen?

guidance.en: Examine him at the cot side.

hint.zh-CN: 胆红素要怎样分开看？哪一项结果需要在几个小时内处理？任何有创操作之前，什么必须先确保安全？
hint.en: How should the bilirubin be split, which result needs action within hours, and what must be made safe before anything invasive?

guidance.zh-CN: 开出入院化验，在会诊板作答决策1，并在床旁落实处理。
guidance.en: Order the admission bloods, answer decision 1 on the case board and carry out the plan at the cot side.

title.zh-CN: 把代谢结果和影像放在一起看
title.en: Put the metabolic results and the imaging together

hint.zh-CN: 每项结果分别指向什么？有没有一种解释能说明全部？什么检查才能真正回答胆管的问题？
hint.en: What does each result point to, can one explanation account for all of them, and which test can truly answer the bile-duct question?

guidance.zh-CN: 开具并查看代谢化验和肝胆影像，在会诊板作答决策2和决策3。
guidance.en: Order and read the metabolic tests and the liver imaging, then answer decisions 2 and 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 解读基因结果和此后的病程
title.en: Weigh the genetic result and his course since

hint.zh-CN: 基因结果对他和他的父母意味着什么？它能解释你看到的全部情况吗？
hint.en: What does the genetic result mean for him and for his parents — and does it explain everything you have seen?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看基因结果和病程记录，再看看他，作答决策4。
guidance.en: Read the genetic result and the progress note, look at him again and answer decision 4.

title.zh-CN: 和家属商量下一步，回顾结局
title.en: Plan with his family and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 家属已经知道什么、担心什么？你怎样把两种情况和时间的紧迫讲清楚？
hint.en: What do they already know and fear, and how will you explain the two conditions and why time matters?

guidance.zh-CN: 安排家属谈话，作答决策5，最后调阅转归记录。
guidance.en: Arrange the family meeting, answer decision 5, then read the outcome record.

prompt.zh-CN: 2月龄男婴，生后第3天起黄疸、逐渐加深，大便淡黄色，曾住院用药一周无好转；肝、脾均在肋下2.5 cm。总胆红素188.0 μmol/L，直接胆红素110.4 μmol/L，GGT 152 U/L，白蛋白23.6 g/L，PT 21.3 s，APTT 79 s。你怎么判断？接下来几个小时做什么？
prompt.en: A 2-month-old boy has been jaundiced since day 3, deepening, with pale-yellow stools and no improvement after a week of medicine; his liver and spleen are each 2.5 cm below the costal margin. Total bilirubin 188.0 µmol/L, direct 110.4 µmol/L, GGT 152 U/L, albumin 23.6 g/L, PT 21.3 s, APTT 79 s. How do you read this, and what do you do in the next few hours?

need.zh-CN: 先问清黄疸的经过和大便颜色，摸他的肝脾，并查看肝功能和凝血结果。
need.en: First take the history of the jaundice and the stool colour, feel his liver and spleen, and read the liver tests and the clotting screen.

text.zh-CN: 结合胆红素升高的胆汁淤积伴凝血异常：立即静脉注射维生素K并复查凝血，当天并行超声及代谢、感染和甲状腺筛查，同时紧急转诊排除胆道闭锁
text.en: Conjugated jaundice with a coagulopathy: IV vitamin K now with a repeat clotting screen, and a same-day parallel work-up — ultrasound and metabolic, infection and thyroid screens — with urgent referral to exclude biliary atresia

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。直接胆红素>17 μmol/L无论总胆红素多少都是病理性的（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐3）；国家卫健委2025年版指南还要求直接胆红素占总胆红素>20%——本例为110.4/188.0 μmol/L。胆汁淤积婴儿的PT延长先按维生素K缺乏处理，因口服吸收不良须注射给药；注射后仍不能纠正，就要考虑肝脏合成功能受损或其他原因（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017列出妊娠期同种免疫性肝病、代谢病和败血症）。婴儿超过6周龄时，胆道闭锁的评估要加快，并与可治疗病因的筛查同时进行。
feedback.en: Right. A direct bilirubin above 17 µmol/L is pathological whatever the total (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendation 3); the 2025 Chinese national guideline also uses a direct-to-total ratio above 20 % — here 110.4 of 188.0 µmol/L. In a cholestatic infant a prolonged PT is treated first as vitamin K deficiency, by injection because oral absorption is impaired; clotting that does not then correct raises impaired synthesis or another cause (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 names gestational alloimmune liver disease, metabolic disease and sepsis). Over six weeks of age the evaluation for biliary atresia is expedited, alongside the treatable causes.

text.zh-CN: 直接胆红素不到总胆红素的三分之二，仍以母乳性黄疸为主：暂停母乳48小时，回家口服维生素K，一周后复查胆红素并观察大便颜色
text.en: The direct fraction is under two-thirds of the total, so this is still mainly breast-milk jaundice: pause breastfeeding for 48 hours, start oral vitamin K at home, and recheck the bilirubin and the stools in a week

feedback.zh-CN: 母乳性黄疸是非结合胆红素升高；NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017规定直接胆红素>17 μmol/L即为病理性，不论它占总胆红素多少，110.4 μmol/L是这个界值的6倍多。胆道闭锁的婴儿通常看起来很好、长得也好，所以黄疸常被误当成母乳性黄疸。胆汁淤积时口服维生素K吸收不良；2个月大时再等一周，会降低Kasai手术的效果。
feedback.en: Breast-milk jaundice is unconjugated; NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 counts any direct bilirubin above 17 µmol/L as pathological whatever its share of the total, and 110.4 µmol/L is more than six times that. Infants with biliary atresia usually look well and grow, which is exactly why their jaundice is put down to breastfeeding. Oral vitamin K is poorly absorbed in cholestasis, and a week's wait at two months costs Kasai outcome.

text.zh-CN: 大便是淡黄色、从未见过白陶土样，吃奶也好，胆道闭锁可能性不大：先筛查感染、甲状腺和代谢原因，这些都阴性后再请外科会诊
text.en: His stools are pale yellow and never clay-white, and he feeds and responds well, so biliary atresia is unlikely: screen first for infection, thyroid and metabolic causes, and involve the surgeons only if all of these come back negative

feedback.zh-CN: 大便颜色变浅即使不是白色也是警示：NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017引用的研究中，只有63%的医务人员能认出白陶土样便，指南要求医生亲自查看大便（推荐5）。胆道闭锁的评估要与可治疗病因的筛查同时进行，而不是等它们都排除之后；婴儿超过6周龄时更要加快。
feedback.en: Pale stools are a warning even when they are not white: in a study NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 cites, only 63 % of health professionals recognised acholic stools, and the guideline asks clinicians to look at the stool themselves (recommendation 5). Biliary atresia is evaluated in parallel with the treatable causes, not after them, and quickly once an infant is over six weeks old.

text.zh-CN: PT 21.3 s加上白蛋白23.6 g/L说明已经是肝衰竭：现在就输新鲜冰冻血浆纠正凝血，并转诊肝移植评估，不必再在其他诊断检查上耽误时间
text.en: A PT of 21.3 s with an albumin of 23.6 g/L means established liver failure: give fresh frozen plasma now and refer him for liver transplant assessment rather than spending time on further diagnostic tests

feedback.zh-CN: 胆汁淤积婴儿的PT延长在证明不是之前都按维生素K缺乏处理，先注射维生素K再复查；NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017指出，注射维生素K后仍不纠正、且与肝损伤程度不相称的严重凝血障碍，才提示妊娠期同种免疫性肝病、代谢病或败血症。血浆只能短暂纠正凝血；肝移植评估也不能代替查找可治疗的病因——对胆道闭锁，首先是Kasai手术。
feedback.en: In a cholestatic infant a prolonged PT is vitamin K deficiency until shown otherwise, corrected with parenteral vitamin K and rechecked; NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 reserves gestational alloimmune liver disease, metabolic disease or sepsis for a severe coagulopathy that does not respond and is out of proportion to the liver injury. Plasma corrects clotting only briefly, and transplant assessment does not replace finding a treatable cause: for biliary atresia, a Kasai operation comes first.

prompt.zh-CN: 进一步结果：血氨156 μmol/L；瓜氨酸354.86 μmol/L，多种氨基酸升高；AFP 451055 ng/mL。超声提示胆道闭锁可能；MRCP未显示肝总管和胆总管，胆囊极小。这些结果怎样放在一起理解？
prompt.en: Further results: ammonia 156 µmol/L; citrulline 354.86 µmol/L with several amino acids raised; AFP 451055 ng/mL. The ultrasound raises the possibility of biliary atresia; MRCP shows neither the common hepatic nor the common bile duct, and a very small gallbladder. How do these fit together?

need.zh-CN: 先查看血氨、氨基酸、甲胎蛋白以及超声和MRCP结果。
need.en: First read the ammonia, amino acids and AFP, and the ultrasound and MRCP reports.

text.zh-CN: 两种病要一起追查：瓜氨酸、血氨和AFP指向citrin缺陷，送SLC25A13基因检测；但它解释不了看不到的肝外胆管和极小的胆囊，胆道闭锁仍需胆道造影排除
text.en: Two disorders to pursue together: citrulline, ammonia and AFP point to citrin deficiency (send SLC25A13 testing), but it cannot explain unseen extrahepatic ducts and a tiny gallbladder — atresia still needs cholangiography

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。citrin缺陷在小婴儿中的典型表现是胆汁淤积、高氨血症和高瓜氨酸血症，由SLC25A13基因检测确诊（Inui等，亚太儿科胃肠肝病营养学会专家意见，2024）。但一个诊断不能排除另一个：本例超声本身就提示胆道闭锁可能，MRCP又见胆囊极小、胆管未显示；NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017把超声上胆囊异常或缺如列为必须评估胆道闭锁的危险信号，而它引用的研究中MRCP的特异度只有36%。国家卫健委2025年版指南把citrin缺陷列为需与胆道闭锁鉴别的疾病；本例两个问题都需要回答。
feedback.en: Right. Citrin deficiency typically presents in young infants with cholestasis, hyperammonaemia and hypercitrullinaemia and is confirmed by SLC25A13 testing (Inui et al., APPSPGHAN expert review 2024). But one diagnosis does not exclude another: here the ultrasound itself raised atresia and MRCP showed a very small gallbladder with the ducts unseen; NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 counts an abnormal or absent gallbladder on ultrasound among the red flags that mandate evaluation for biliary atresia, and MRCP had a specificity of only 36 % in the study it cites. The 2025 Chinese national guideline lists citrin deficiency among the conditions to tell from atresia; here both questions need an answer.

text.zh-CN: citrin缺陷就能解释全部表现——胆汁流少，胆囊就小，胆管细到MRCP看不见——所以先用特殊配方奶，等SLC25A13结果，黄疸消退后再复查超声和MRCP
text.en: Citrin deficiency explains all of it — poor bile flow leaves the gallbladder small and the ducts too thin to see on MRCP — so treat with a special formula, await the SLC25A13 result and repeat the ultrasound and MRCP once the jaundice settles

feedback.zh-CN: NICCD确实会引起胆汁淤积，所以这个想法很诱人；但看不到肝总管和胆总管、胆囊极小，正是胆道闭锁的表现，影像检查也不能排除它（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐6和8）。等基因结果、试用配方奶要耽误几周，而Kasai术后胆汁引流成功率在生后60天内约70%，90天后不到25%。
feedback.en: NICCD does cause cholestasis, which is why this is tempting, but common hepatic and common bile ducts that cannot be seen, with a tiny gallbladder, are what biliary atresia looks like, and imaging cannot exclude it (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendations 6 and 8). Waiting for the gene result and a formula trial costs weeks when Kasai drainage falls from about 70 % within 60 days of life to under 25 % after 90.

text.zh-CN: MRCP已经证明是胆道闭锁，直接做Kasai手术即可；氨基酸和AFP升高只是胆汁淤积的非特异表现，不需要代谢方面的检查，也不用改变喂养
text.en: The MRCP proves biliary atresia, so proceed straight to a Kasai operation; the amino acids and AFP are non-specific effects of the cholestasis and need neither a metabolic work-up nor any change of feeds

feedback.zh-CN: MRCP不能证明胆道闭锁（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐8）；胆道造影加组织学检查才是金标准（推荐10；国家卫健委2025年版指南写明为腹腔镜或开腹胆道探查）。忽视代谢表现同样不安全：citrin缺陷会改变他的喂养和围手术期补液，因为GeneReviews（2025年修订）把葡萄糖输注列为citrin缺陷需要避免的情况，Okano等（2019）也指出应避免持续输注高浓度葡萄糖的静脉营养。
feedback.en: MRCP cannot prove biliary atresia (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendation 8); cholangiography with histology is the gold standard (recommendation 10; the 2025 Chinese guideline names laparoscopic or open exploration). Ignoring the metabolic picture is unsafe too: citrin deficiency changes his feeds and his peri-operative fluids, because GeneReviews (revised 2025) lists glucose infusions among what to avoid in it and Okano et al. 2019 warn against continuous high-glucose intravenous feeding.

text.zh-CN: 血氨和瓜氨酸升高说明是尿素循环障碍：停奶、禁蛋白，输注高浓度葡萄糖并用降氨药，等血氨正常后再考虑胆管的问题
text.en: The ammonia and citrulline mean a urea-cycle disorder: stop milk and protein, start a high-concentration glucose infusion and an ammonia scavenger, and leave the bile-duct question until the ammonia is normal

feedback.zh-CN: citrin缺陷不能按经典尿素循环障碍处理：GeneReviews（2025年修订）把葡萄糖输注和低蛋白、高碳水化合物饮食列为需要避免的情况，Okano等（2019）也指出应避免持续输注高浓度葡萄糖的静脉营养；患儿应改用无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶，而不是禁蛋白（Inui等，2024）。把胆管问题搁置，也会耗掉Kasai手术所依赖的时间。
feedback.en: Citrin deficiency is not managed like a classic urea-cycle disorder: GeneReviews (revised 2025) lists glucose infusions and low-protein, high-carbohydrate diets among what to avoid, Okano et al. 2019 warn against continuous high-glucose intravenous feeding, and infants are given a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula rather than being starved of protein (Inui et al. 2024). Setting the bile-duct question aside also spends the time a Kasai operation depends on.

prompt.zh-CN: 小儿外科今天可以来会诊。他入院时凝血PT 21.3 s，APTT 79 s。你打算怎样回答胆管通不通这个问题？
prompt.en: The paediatric surgeons can see him today. His clotting on admission was PT 21.3 s and APTT 79 s. How will you answer the question of whether his bile ducts are open?

need.zh-CN: 先对代谢结果和影像作出判断。
need.en: First decide how the metabolic results and the imaging fit together.

text.zh-CN: 静脉注射维生素K纠正凝血后尽快做胆道造影加肝活检（腹腔镜或开腹，证实闭锁则同次行Kasai手术），特殊配方奶和基因检测同时进行
text.en: Cholangiography with a liver biopsy once IV vitamin K has corrected the clotting — laparoscopic or open, a Kasai at the same sitting if atresia is found — with the formula and the gene test running alongside

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胆道造影加组织学检查是诊断胆道闭锁的金标准（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐10），证实后通常同次行Kasai手术。国家卫健委2025年版指南要求在不能排除胆道闭锁时于生后45天内行胆道造影；他已经2个月大，早已超过这个时间，因此任何事情都不应等基因结果。维生素K和复查凝血保证手术安全；针对citrin缺陷的喂养调整和基因检测同时进行。
feedback.en: Right. Cholangiography with histology is the gold standard for biliary atresia (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendation 10), and if atresia is confirmed a Kasai operation is usually done at once. The 2025 Chinese national guideline asks for cholangiography within 45 days of life when atresia cannot be excluded; at two months he is already past that, so nothing should wait for the gene result. Vitamin K and a repeat clotting screen make the operation safe; the feeds and the genetic test for citrin deficiency run in parallel.

text.zh-CN: 今天就在病房做超声引导下经皮肝穿刺，先在citrin缺陷和胆道闭锁之间作出判断，再决定是否手术；如果穿刺点渗血不止，再补充维生素K
text.en: A percutaneous liver biopsy on the ward today, under ultrasound guidance, to decide between citrin deficiency and atresia before anyone operates; vitamin K can be given afterwards if the biopsy site keeps oozing

feedback.zh-CN: 肝活检很有价值（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐9），但不能在凝血未纠正时做：指南引用的一组婴儿肝活检中4.6%发生需要干预的出血，维生素K要在穿刺之前给，而不是之后。影像已经提示胆道闭锁，直接做胆道造影、在同次手术中取活检，更快也更安全。
feedback.en: Liver biopsy is valuable (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendation 9), but not with uncorrected clotting: bleeding that needed intervention followed 4.6 % of infant biopsies in a series the guideline cites, and vitamin K comes before the needle, not after it. With imaging that already raises atresia, going straight to cholangiography, with the biopsy taken at the same operation, is quicker and safer.

text.zh-CN: 先等SLC25A13结果，并试用四周无乳糖MCT配方奶：黄疸消退就免了手术；如果不退，到那时再预约胆道造影
text.en: Await the SLC25A13 result and give a four-week trial of lactose-free MCT formula: if the jaundice clears he is spared an operation altogether, and if it does not, the cholangiogram can be booked at that point

feedback.zh-CN: 这样做是在等代谢问题的答案，却耗掉了胆管等不起的几周：生后60天内手术约70%能恢复胆汁引流，90天后不到25%（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017），而他已经2个月大。配方奶试验和基因检测可以与胆道造影同时进行；它们都不能说明胆管是否通畅。
feedback.en: This waits on the metabolic question and spends weeks the bile ducts do not have: bile flow is restored in about 70 % of infants operated within 60 days of life but fewer than 25 % after 90 (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017), and he is already two months old. A formula trial and a gene test can run alongside the cholangiogram; neither can show whether the ducts are open.

text.zh-CN: 先做肝胆核素显像：示踪剂进入肠道说明胆管通畅，就不用手术；如果不进入，等显像报告出来后再转去做胆道造影
text.en: A hepatobiliary scintigraphy scan first: if the tracer reaches the bowel the ducts are open and no operation is needed; if it does not, refer him for cholangiography once the scan is reported

feedback.zh-CN: 核素显像的作用有限（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐7）：指南引用的比较研究中其特异度只有45.7%，因为许多不是胆道闭锁的胆汁淤积婴儿也不排泄。对胆汁淤积这样明显的婴儿，不排泄的结果说明不了问题，多一步只会多耽误时间；只有明确看到排泄才能排除胆道闭锁。
feedback.en: Scintigraphy has a limited role (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendation 7): its specificity was 45.7 % in a comparison the guideline cites, because many cholestatic infants without atresia have non-excreting scans. In an infant this cholestatic a non-excreting scan settles nothing and the extra step adds delay; only clearly demonstrated excretion would exclude atresia.

prompt.zh-CN: 基因结果：SLC25A13 p.E252K（来自母亲）和c.852_855delTATG（来自父亲）。病程记录写明营养治疗后血氨改善，但他仍有黄疸。这说明了什么？
prompt.en: The genetic result: SLC25A13 p.E252K (from his mother) and c.852_855delTATG (from his father). The progress note says his ammonia improved after nutritional treatment, but he is still jaundiced. What does this tell you?

need.zh-CN: 先查看基因检测结果和治疗后的病程记录。
need.en: First read the genetic result and the progress note on his course since.

text.zh-CN: 父母各传一个变异，确诊citrin缺陷，血氨改善也符合NICCD得到治疗；但这解释不了黄疸持续和看不到的胆管，胆道闭锁仍需立即胆道造影
text.en: Two variants, one from each parent, confirm citrin deficiency and the better ammonia fits treated NICCD, but that cannot explain persisting jaundice with unseen ducts: atresia needs cholangiography now

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。基因的两个拷贝上各有一个变异、分别来自父母，即复合杂合；在常染色体隐性遗传病中，这意味着他是患者（Inui等，2024）。多数NICCD婴儿在无乳糖、富含MCT的喂养下约1岁时肝功能恢复，所以代谢指标改善是预料中的；血氨改善而黄疸持续、胆管始终看不到，提示还有第二个问题。基因结果回答的是代谢问题，而不是结构问题。
feedback.en: Right. One variant on each copy of the gene, one from each parent, is compound heterozygosity — in an autosomal recessive disease that makes him affected (Inui et al. 2024). Most infants with NICCD recover liver function by about a year on lactose-free, MCT-enriched feeds, so a metabolic response is expected; jaundice that persists while the ammonia improves, with ducts never seen, is the sign of a second problem. A gene result answers the metabolic question, not the structural one.

text.zh-CN: 父母各传给他一个变异，所以他和父母一样只是携带者：citrin缺陷可以排除，瓜氨酸升高一定是胆道闭锁造成的肝损害所致
text.en: Each parent passed on one variant, so like them he is only a carrier: citrin deficiency is excluded, and the raised citrulline must come from the liver injury that biliary atresia causes

feedback.zh-CN: 携带者只有一个变异；他有两个，分别在两个拷贝上——复合杂合，在常染色体隐性遗传病中意味着患病（Inui等，2024）。这个结果确诊了citrin缺陷，也解释了瓜氨酸升高；仍未回答的是胆管问题。
feedback.en: A carrier has one variant; he has two, one on each copy — compound heterozygosity, which in an autosomal recessive disease means he is affected (Inui et al. 2024). The result confirms citrin deficiency, which explains the citrulline; it is the bile-duct question that remains open.

text.zh-CN: 诊断已经明确是NICCD，它通常在12个月左右自行缓解：继续用现在的配方奶，每个月复查一次胆红素，到6个月时如果还是黄，再考虑检查胆管
text.en: The diagnosis is now settled as NICCD, which usually resolves by about 12 months of age: continue the formula, check the bilirubin every month, and look at the bile ducts only if he is still jaundiced at six months

feedback.zh-CN: NICCD通常确实在1岁左右缓解（Okano等，2019；Inui等，2024），所以这个选择很诱人——报告中的腹腔镜检查也是在后来再次入院时才做的。但确诊一个代谢病并不能排除另一个病；胆管始终没看到，再等几个月，会让他远远超过Kasai手术还有效的日龄（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017：90天后胆汁引流成功不到25%）。
feedback.en: NICCD usually does settle by about a year (Okano et al. 2019; Inui et al. 2024), which is why this tempts — and the report records the laparoscopy only at a later readmission. But a confirmed metabolic diagnosis does not exclude a second one, and waiting months with ducts that have never been seen would take him far past the age at which a Kasai operation works (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017: under 25 % drain after 90 days).

text.zh-CN: 血氨改善说明胆汁已经流通了：胆管可能只是太细，MRCP显示不出来，所以一个月后复查超声即可，不必让他做手术
text.en: The improved ammonia shows that bile is flowing again: the ducts were probably just too thin for MRCP to show, so repeat the ultrasound in a month rather than put him through an operation

feedback.zh-CN: 血氨反映的是尿素循环和对喂养的反应，而不是胆汁引流，它的改善不能说明肝外胆管是否通畅。这里反映胆汁流动的是黄疸，而黄疸仍然持续。超声和MRCP都不能排除胆道闭锁（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017）。
feedback.en: Ammonia reflects the urea cycle and his response to feeding, not bile drainage, so its improvement says nothing about whether the extrahepatic ducts are open. The jaundice is the bile-flow marker here, and it persists. Neither ultrasound nor MRCP can exclude biliary atresia (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017).

prompt.zh-CN: 你要和家属见面商量下一步。他们已经知道基因检测找到了黄疸的原因。你打算怎样进行这次谈话？
prompt.en: You are meeting his family to plan the next step. They know the gene test has found a cause for his jaundice. How do you approach the conversation?

need.zh-CN: 先解读基因结果和此后的病程。
need.en: First interpret the genetic result and his course since.

text.zh-CN: 先问家属知道什么、担心什么；讲清基因只解释了代谢部分、解释不了胆管，胆道造影和可能的Kasai手术为什么要抓紧，以后可能要肝移植；回授法确认，约定日期
text.en: Ask what they know and fear; explain that the gene result covers the metabolic part but not the ducts, what cholangiography and a possible Kasai involve and why timing matters, that a transplant may follow; teach-back; agree a date

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。SPIKES提供了谈话的结构——环境、了解家属的认识、他们想知道多少、用通俗的话告知、回应情绪、共同制定计划——回授法确认他们真正听懂了。家属需要坦诚的信息：Kasai手术是保留自体肝的最好机会，而且越早越好（国家卫健委2025年版：生后45天内最佳，超过90天效果不佳；未及时做Kasai手术的话，胆道闭锁患儿通常难以依靠自体肝活过1岁），很多孩子以后仍需肝移植；citrin缺陷是常染色体隐性遗传，以后每次怀孕有1/4的机会。
feedback.en: Right. SPIKES gives the structure — setting, their perception, how much they want to know, knowledge in plain words, empathy, a shared plan — and teach-back confirms what they have taken in. They need an honest account: a Kasai operation offers the best chance of keeping his own liver and works best early (NHC 2025: best within 45 days, poor after 90; without a timely Kasai, infants with atresia rarely live beyond a year on their own liver), many children still need a transplant later, and citrin deficiency is autosomal recessive, with a 1 in 4 chance in each future pregnancy.

text.zh-CN: 安慰家属：基因检测已经把黄疸的原因查清楚了，NICCD通常1岁左右就会好；如果到时候黄疸还不退再谈手术，现在没有必要让他们为手术担心，先约好门诊定期复查
text.en: Reassure them that the gene test has explained the jaundice and that NICCD usually settles by about a year; an operation can be raised later if he is still yellow, so there is no need to worry them about one now — book a clinic review

feedback.zh-CN: 虚假的安慰剥夺了家属做决定所需要的信息：基因结果既解释不了看不到的胆管，也解释不了持续的黄疸；每拖延一周，Kasai手术成功的机会就更小（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017）。共同决策需要把不确定性如实、温和地讲出来。
feedback.en: False reassurance withholds what the family need in order to decide: the gene result explains neither the unseen ducts nor the persisting jaundice, and each week of delay lowers the chance that a Kasai operation works (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017). Shared decision-making needs the uncertainty told truthfully, and kindly.

text.zh-CN: 明确告诉家属：不马上手术孩子一定会死于肝衰竭，外科医生最清楚该怎么做，请他们离开房间前就签好手术同意书，免得再耽误时间
text.en: Tell them firmly that without an operation tomorrow he will certainly die of liver failure, that the surgeons know best, and ask them to sign the consent form before they leave the room so that no more time is lost on discussion

feedback.zh-CN: 紧迫是真的，但虚假的确定性和施压既不诚实也没有效果：胆道造影不一定证实闭锁，Kasai手术也不是根治，在压力下签的同意书不是真正的知情同意。把利害和时间要求讲清楚，给家属考虑的空间和一个很近的日期，并提出可以再谈一次。
feedback.en: The urgency is real, but false certainty and pressure are neither honest nor effective: the cholangiogram may not show atresia, a Kasai operation is not a cure, and consent given under pressure is not informed. Explain the stakes and the time frame plainly, give them space and a near date, and offer a second meeting.

text.zh-CN: 建议家属：Kasai手术反正常常失败，不如跳过它，现在就排队做肝移植，一步同时解决胆管问题和citrin缺陷
text.en: Advise them that a Kasai operation often fails anyway, so it is kinder to skip it and list him for a liver transplant now, which would cure both the bile-duct problem and the citrin deficiency in a single step

feedback.zh-CN: 直接肝移植适用于就诊过晚、已有失代偿肝硬化或肝衰竭的婴儿（国家卫健委2025年版指南列出的指征包括失代偿期肝硬化、肝衰竭、门静脉高压导致的反复消化道出血）；其他情况首先做Kasai手术——NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017引用的法国大宗病例中，全部患儿约三分之一10年时仍保留自体肝，手术越晚比例越低。用误导性的说法引导家属，不是共同决策。
feedback.en: A primary transplant is for infants who present late with decompensated cirrhosis or liver failure (the 2025 Chinese guideline's indications include decompensated cirrhosis, liver failure and recurrent bleeding from portal hypertension); otherwise the Kasai operation comes first: in the large French series NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 quotes, about a third of all the children still had their own liver at ten years, fewer the later the operation. Steering a family with a misleading account of the options is not shared decision-making.

text.zh-CN: 问清黄疸起病和变化、大小便颜色、喂养和精神，以及之前的住院治疗
text.en: Established the onset and course of the jaundice, the stool and urine colour, feeding and alertness, and the earlier admission and its treatment

text.zh-CN: 了解出生情况和家族史（父亲乙肝、母亲和姐姐的健康、遗传病），并问及出生后的维生素K和出血情况
text.en: Asked about his birth and family (his father's hepatitis B, his mother's and sister's health, inherited disease), vitamin K after birth and any bleeding

text.zh-CN: 查看皮肤和巩膜、反应、体重和腹部，并触诊肝脾
text.en: Examined skin and sclerae, responsiveness, weight and abdomen, and palpated the liver and spleen

text.zh-CN: 入院时查看分次胆红素和凝血，并送检血糖、甲状腺功能和先天感染筛查
text.en: Read the split bilirubin and the clotting on admission, and sent glucose, thyroid function and the congenital infection screen

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把首批结果判断为需要紧急处理的胆汁淤积
text.en: Read the first results as cholestasis needing urgent action, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 及时注射维生素K：在基因结果回报和任何有创检查之前
text.en: Gave vitamin K by injection in time — before the genetic result and any invasive test

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认识到代谢病和胆道结构问题可能并存
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that a metabolic and a structural disease may coexist

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择尽快行胆道造影，并及早送检基因、调整喂养
text.en: Chose prompt cholangiography at the first attempt, sent the gene test early and changed the feeds

text.zh-CN: 在基因结果回报之前就请小儿外科安排胆道造影
text.en: Referred him to paediatric surgery for cholangiography before the genetic result was back

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确解读复合杂合结果，并指出它不能解释的部分
text.en: Read the compound heterozygous result correctly at the first attempt, including what it cannot explain

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择坦诚、共同决策的沟通方式，安排家属谈话并提供遗传咨询
text.en: Chose an honest, shared conversation at the first attempt, held the family meeting and offered genetic counselling

text.zh-CN: 补充脂溶性维生素，请遗传代谢科会诊，并亲自查看大便颜色
text.en: Gave fat-soluble vitamins, asked the metabolic team to advise, and looked at the stool colour

text.zh-CN: 没有做有害的处置：光疗退黄、按尿素循环障碍停奶输高糖、凝血未纠正时在病房肝穿刺、出院等待
text.en: Avoided the harmful steps: phototherapy, a urea-cycle regimen with high glucose, a ward liver biopsy before the clotting is corrected, and discharge to wait

text.zh-CN: 与家属讨论两种疾病、手术的必要性和时机
text.en: Discussed both conditions and the need for, and timing of, the operation with the family

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：安静的房间，上级医师和小儿外科医生在场，留出足够时间（Calgary–Cambridge：开始、收集信息、解释与计划）。先问家属已经知道什么、担心什么——他们刚听说基因检测找到了原因，可能以为事情到此为止。用通俗的话说明：基因结果解释了代谢的部分（citrin缺陷，换特殊奶粉后多数会好转），却解释不了为什么胆管看不到、为什么孩子还黄；只有腹腔镜（小切口看一看）加胆道造影和肝组织检查才能弄清楚；如果胆管确实堵了，Kasai手术最好同次做，因为两个月以后每过一周成功的机会都在下降；Kasai手术不是根治，以后可能还需要肝移植；手术前打维生素K是为了安全。回应情绪（SPIKES），不要往任何一个方向说得太绝对；给出很近的日期并约好再谈；说明常染色体隐性遗传（以后每次怀孕1/4的机会）并提供遗传咨询；用回授法确认家属听懂了，并书面记录。不施压、不虚假安慰，也不把肝移植说成可以替代查明原因的办法。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: a quiet room, the senior doctor and the surgeon present, enough time (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning). Starts by asking what the family understand and fear — they have just heard that the gene test found a cause and may expect that to end the matter. Explains in plain words that the result explains the metabolic part (citrin deficiency, which usually improves on a special milk) but not why the bile ducts could not be seen or why he is still yellow; that only a laparoscopy (a keyhole look) with a dye test of the bile ducts and a liver sample can settle it; that if the ducts are blocked a Kasai operation is best done at the same time, because after two months its chance of working falls week by week; that a Kasai operation is not a cure and a transplant may be needed later; and that the vitamin K is to make the operation safe. Responds to emotion (SPIKES) and avoids certainty in either direction; offers a near date and a second meeting; explains autosomal recessive inheritance (a 1 in 4 chance in each future pregnancy) and offers genetic counselling; checks understanding by teach-back and documents the discussion. Does not pressure, does not falsely reassure, and does not present a transplant as a substitute for finding out.

name.zh-CN: 卓医生（儿童消化肝病科上级医师）
name.en: Dr Zhuo (paediatric gastroenterology and hepatology attending)

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童消化肝病科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，结束时用PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“两个月大的婴儿黄疸，第一件要分清的是什么？”“胆汁淤积的婴儿凝血时间延长，最先考虑什么原因，怎么处理？做有创检查前要确认什么？”“一个代谢诊断能不能解释所有影像表现？”“超声和MRCP能排除胆道闭锁吗？什么检查才能？”“基因结果确认之后，还剩下什么没有回答？”“你会怎样和家属谈手术？”说明这是2013年发表的历史病例：当年的流程不能当作今天的标准。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局，陷阱和答案留到复盘时再讲；生命体征、转氨酶、上次住院用的药和做过的检查、出生后是否用过维生素K、新生儿筛查、营养治疗的具体方案、腹腔镜时的月龄、是否做了胆道造影、家属不接受Kasai手术的理由和以后的结局都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric gastroenterology and hepatology attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “In a two-month-old with jaundice, what is the first thing to sort out?”, “What is the first cause to think of when a cholestatic infant's clotting is prolonged, how do you treat it, and what must be confirmed before anything invasive?”, “Can one metabolic diagnosis explain all the imaging?”, “Can ultrasound or MRCP exclude biliary atresia — and what can?”, “Once the gene result is in, what is still unanswered?”, “How will you talk to the family about an operation?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2013: its course is not today's standard. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early, and keeps the traps and the answers for the debrief; his vital signs, transaminases, the earlier medicines and tests, vitamin K after birth, newborn screening, the nutritional regimen, his age at laparoscopy, whether a cholangiogram was done, the family's reasons for not accepting a Kasai operation and his later course are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：S——2月龄男婴，因黄疸约2个月收入病房；B——生后第3天起皮肤发黄、逐渐加深，尿黄，大便淡黄色，吃奶、精神尚可，一个半月时住院用药一周未见好转；A——皮肤和巩膜黄染，家属在床旁；R——请医生评估并开医嘱。可以协助：称体重，开放静脉通路和采血，按医嘱给药（复述剂量），留取新鲜大便对照比色卡，按医嘱更换奶粉。只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（生命体征、出生后是否用过维生素K、上次用过什么药）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): S — boy aged two months admitted with about two months of jaundice; B — yellow since his third day of life and deepening, yellow urine, pale-yellow stools, feeding and alertness fair, a week of medicine during an admission at about six weeks without improvement; A — jaundiced skin and sclerae, a relative at the cot side; R — please assess him and write the orders. Can help to weigh him, site IV access and take bloods, give medicines as prescribed (reading the dose back), keep a fresh stool for the colour card and change his feeds as prescribed. Reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (his vital signs, vitamin K after birth, the medicines he had last time).

knowledge.zh-CN: 小儿外科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的超声和MRCP结果。可以讲：腹腔镜或开腹胆道造影加组织学检查是确诊或排除胆道闭锁的金标准（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017；国家卫健委《先天性胆道闭锁诊疗指南（2025版）》），证实后通常同次行Kasai手术，肝活检可在同次手术中取得；手术前要先注射维生素K纠正凝血并复查；Kasai手术效果与日龄密切相关：生后60天内完成约70%能恢复胆汁引流，90天后不到25%（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017），国家卫健委2025年版以45天内为最佳；Kasai失败或就诊过晚、已失代偿者考虑肝移植。不提前透露本例手术所见或结局。
knowledge.en: Paediatric surgery consultant who interprets only the ultrasound and MRCP results the learner has read. Can explain that laparoscopic or open cholangiography with histology is the gold standard to confirm or exclude biliary atresia (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017; the 2025 Chinese national guideline), that a Kasai operation usually follows at the same sitting if atresia is confirmed and the liver biopsy can be taken then; that the clotting is corrected with injected vitamin K and rechecked first; that the result of a Kasai operation depends closely on age — bile flow in about 70 % when done within 60 days of life and in fewer than 25 % after 90 (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017), best within 45 days in the 2025 Chinese guideline; and that transplantation is considered when a Kasai operation fails or presentation is too late, with decompensated disease. Never reveals what this baby's operation found or the outcome early.

name.zh-CN: 邵医生（遗传代谢科会诊）
name.en: Dr Shao (metabolic and genetic medicine consultant)

knowledge.zh-CN: 遗传代谢科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的血氨、氨基酸、甲胎蛋白和基因结果。可以讲：citrin缺陷是SLC25A13基因的常染色体隐性遗传病，小婴儿表现为胆汁淤积、高氨血症、高瓜氨酸血症和脂肪肝（Inui等，2024）；分别来自父母的两个变异即复合杂合，可以确诊；治疗是无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶和脂溶性维生素，多数在1岁左右恢复，少数进展需肝移植（Okano等，2019；Inui等，2024）；应避免葡萄糖、甘油和果糖输注（有脑水肿风险）及低蛋白、高碳水化合物饮食（GeneReviews，2025年修订），也应避免持续输注高浓度葡萄糖的静脉营养（Okano等，2019）；父母再生育时每胎患病机会1/4。强调代谢诊断不能排除胆道闭锁。不提前给出决策答案或结局。
knowledge.en: Metabolic and genetic medicine consultant who interprets only the ammonia, amino acids, AFP and genetic results the learner has read. Can explain that citrin deficiency is an autosomal recessive SLC25A13 disease presenting in young infants with cholestasis, hyperammonaemia, hypercitrullinaemia and fatty liver (Inui et al. 2024); that two variants, one from each parent, are compound heterozygosity and confirm it; that treatment is a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula with fat-soluble vitamins, most infants recovering by about a year and a few progressing to need a transplant (Okano et al. 2019; Inui et al. 2024); that glucose, glycerol and fructose infusions (for the risk of brain oedema) and low-protein, high-carbohydrate diets are to be avoided (GeneReviews, revised 2025), as is continuous high-glucose intravenous feeding (Okano et al. 2019); and that each future pregnancy has a 1 in 4 chance. Stresses that a metabolic diagnosis does not exclude biliary atresia. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：citrin缺陷与胆道闭锁并存的婴儿胆汁淤积
title.en: Debrief: infant cholestasis with citrin deficiency and biliary atresia together

conclusion.zh-CN: 2月龄足月男婴（出生体重2.9 kg，查体时体重5.2 kg）生后第3天起黄疸并逐渐加深，尿黄，大便淡黄色、从未见白陶土样，精神食欲正常；一个半月时住院用药一周无好转。查体皮肤巩膜黄染、反应好，腹饱满，肝脾均在肋下2.5 cm。总/直接胆红素188.0/110.4 μmol/L，GGT 152 U/L，白蛋白23.6 g/L，PT 21.3 s，APTT 79 s。血氨156 μmol/L、瓜氨酸354.86 μmol/L伴多种氨基酸升高、AFP 451055 ng/mL指向citrin缺陷；超声疑胆道闭锁，MRCP未显示肝总管和胆总管、胆囊极小。SLC25A13为p.E252K（母源）与c.852_855delTATG（父源）复合杂合；营养治疗后血氨改善，但黄疸持续。再次入院时腹腔镜见索状胆囊和肝门部胆管闭锁，活检支持肝外胆道闭锁伴轻度纤维化；家属未接受Kasai手术，长期结局没有记录。现在的做法：直接胆红素升高即按胆汁淤积处理，先注射维生素K纠正凝血，代谢和结构两种解释同时追查，不等基因结果，尽快做胆道造影。
conclusion.en: A two-month-old term boy (birth weight 2.9 kg, 5.2 kg when examined) had been jaundiced since day 3 of life, deepening, with yellow urine and pale-yellow stools never seen clay-white; his alertness and appetite were normal, and a week of medicine during an admission at about six weeks had not helped. His skin and sclerae were jaundiced, he responded well, his abdomen was full, and his liver and spleen were each 2.5 cm below the costal margin. Total/direct bilirubin was 188.0/110.4 µmol/L, GGT 152 U/L, albumin 23.6 g/L, PT 21.3 s and APTT 79 s. Ammonia 156 µmol/L, citrulline 354.86 µmol/L with several amino acids raised and AFP 451055 ng/mL pointed to citrin deficiency, while the ultrasound raised biliary atresia and MRCP showed neither the common hepatic nor the common bile duct and a very small gallbladder. SLC25A13 testing found compound heterozygous p.E252K (maternal) and c.852_855delTATG (paternal) variants; after nutritional treatment the ammonia improved but the jaundice persisted. On a later readmission laparoscopy showed a cord-like gallbladder and atresia of the hilar ducts, and the biopsy supported extrahepatic biliary atresia with mild fibrosis; the family did not accept a Kasai operation, and the long-term outcome is not recorded. Today: treat a raised direct bilirubin as cholestasis at once, correct the clotting with injected vitamin K, pursue the metabolic and the structural explanation together, and take him to cholangiography without waiting for a gene result.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 两个月大时，直接胆红素110.4 μmol/L（约占总胆红素的59%）就是胆汁淤积；大便淡黄而不是白色、吃奶好、精神好，都不能降低紧迫性——胆道闭锁的婴儿通常看起来很好。
keyReasoning.en: At two months, jaundice with a direct bilirubin of 110.4 µmol/L (about 59 % of the total) is cholestasis; stools that are pale yellow rather than white, good feeding and normal alertness do not lower the urgency — infants with biliary atresia usually look well.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胆汁淤积婴儿PT 21.3 s、APTT 79 s，在证明不是之前都按维生素K缺乏处理：先注射维生素K，再做任何穿刺或手术；注射后仍不纠正，就是另一个问题。
keyReasoning.en: A PT of 21.3 s and an APTT of 79 s in a cholestatic infant are vitamin K deficiency until shown otherwise: injected vitamin K comes before any needle or operation, and clotting that will not correct is a different problem.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 瓜氨酸和血氨升高、AFP 451055 ng/mL符合citrin缺陷，但一个代谢诊断解释不了始终看不到的肝外胆管：两种解释要同时追查。
keyReasoning.en: Raised citrulline and ammonia with an AFP of 451055 ng/mL fit citrin deficiency, but a metabolic diagnosis cannot account for extrahepatic ducts that are never seen: both explanations are pursued at the same time.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 影像能缩小问题，不能回答问题：超声和MRCP可以提示胆道闭锁，只有胆道造影加组织学检查能确诊或排除。
keyReasoning.en: Imaging narrows the question but does not answer it: ultrasound and MRCP can suggest biliary atresia; only cholangiography with histology confirms or excludes it.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 复合杂合的SLC25A13结果和血氨改善，说明代谢病在好转；黄疸持续说明胆汁引流的问题仍没有答案。
keyReasoning.en: A compound heterozygous SLC25A13 result and an improving ammonia show the metabolic disease responding; jaundice that persists shows the bile-flow question still unanswered.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 两个月以后，Kasai手术的价值每周都在下降；家属对手术的决定需要一次坦诚、不仓促但及时的谈话。
keyReasoning.en: After two months the value of a Kasai operation falls week by week; the family's decision about it needs an honest conversation that is unhurried but timely.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2013年发表的单例报告，不能据此比较治疗方法，也不能据此判断两种疾病并存时的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；病例没有记录生命体征、出生后是否用过维生素K、营养治疗的具体方案、腹腔镜时的月龄和长期结局，也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2013: it cannot compare treatments or predict the outcome when the two diseases coexist. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; the case records no vital signs, no vitamin K after birth, no nutritional regimen, not his age at laparoscopy and not the long-term outcome, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征，以及心脏、眼、面容、皮肤出血点等其他系统的查体；医护人员对大便颜色的观察。
unknowns.en: Vital signs and the rest of the examination (heart, eyes, facial features, any bruising or petechiae); any staff observation of his stools.

unknowns.zh-CN: 转氨酶、碱性磷酸酶、胆汁酸、血糖、血常规、甲状腺功能、先天感染筛查、他本人的乙肝标志物和新生儿筛查结果；所报数值的参考范围；首批化验的采血日期。
unknowns.en: Transaminases, alkaline phosphatase, bile acids, glucose, full blood count, thyroid function, the congenital infection screen, his own hepatitis B markers and his newborn screening; the reference intervals for the values reported; the day the first samples were taken.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出生时或住院期间是否注射过维生素K，之后的凝血复查结果，以及有无出血。
unknowns.en: Whether vitamin K was given at birth or during either admission, any clotting result after it, and whether he bled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 一个半月时住院用的是什么药、做过哪些检查；营养治疗的具体奶粉或方案、开始时间、复查的血氨数值，以及它与基因结果的先后。
unknowns.en: The medicines and tests of the admission at about six weeks; the feed or regimen of the nutritional treatment, when it started, the repeat ammonia value and its timing relative to the genetic result.

unknowns.zh-CN: 腹腔镜时的月龄、是否做了胆道造影、活检部位和纤维化分级方法。
unknowns.en: His age at the laparoscopy, whether a cholangiogram was done, the biopsy site and the fibrosis scoring used.

unknowns.zh-CN: 家属不接受Kasai手术的理由，之后的治疗（如肝移植评估）、长期肝功能、营养和生存结局；HBsAg阳性的后续核实（没有写明是谁的结果）。
unknowns.en: The family's reasons for not accepting a Kasai operation, his later treatment (such as transplant assessment) and his long-term liver, nutritional and survival outcomes; the follow-up of an HBsAg-positive result (whose is not stated).

unknowns.zh-CN: 父母是否近亲、母亲孕期情况和产前超声、过敏史。
unknowns.en: Whether the parents are related, the pregnancy and antenatal scans, and any allergies.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别胆汁淤积（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017；国家卫健委《先天性胆道闭锁诊疗指南（2025版）》）：足月儿2周后仍有黄疸（母乳喂养、一般情况好者可到3周）要查分次胆红素；直接胆红素>17 μmol/L（1.0 mg/dL）无论总胆红素多少都是病理性的，中国2025年版指南的流程还要求直接胆红素占总胆红素>20%——本例为110.4/188.0 μmol/L。要亲自看大便：指南引用的研究中只有63%的医务人员能认出白陶土样便；中国台湾地区的大便比色卡对浅色大便的敏感度为95.2%。
teachingPoints.en: Recognising cholestasis (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017; the 2025 Chinese national guideline for biliary atresia): a term infant still jaundiced after 2 weeks (3 weeks if breastfed and well) needs a fractionated bilirubin; a direct bilirubin above 17 µmol/L (1.0 mg/dL) is pathological whatever the total, and the 2025 Chinese pathway also uses a direct-to-total ratio above 20 % — here 110.4 of 188.0 µmol/L. Look at the stool yourself: in a study the guideline cites only 63 % of health professionals recognised acholic stools, and Taiwan's stool colour card detected pale stools with 95.2 % sensitivity.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 时间就是肝脏（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017；国家卫健委2025年版）：生后60天内行Kasai手术约70%能恢复胆汁引流，90天后不到25%，自体肝生存率随手术日龄增大而下降（Serinet等的法国大宗病例）；中国2025年版指南以生后45天内为最佳，不能排除胆道闭锁时45日龄内胆道造影。本例入院时已约两个月大；报告记录的腹腔镜检查是在后来再次入院时做的。
teachingPoints.en: Time is liver (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017; NHC 2025): about 70 % of infants regain bile flow when the Kasai operation is done within 60 days of life and fewer than 25 % after 90, and survival with the native liver falls as the age at operation rises (Serinet et al.'s French series). The 2025 Chinese guideline puts the best time within 45 days and asks for cholangiography within 45 days of life when atresia cannot be excluded. This infant was already about two months old on admission; the report records the laparoscopy only at a later readmission.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 怎样确诊（NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017，推荐6–10）：超声可显示胆囊缺如或异常，提示但不能诊断胆道闭锁；核素显像和MRCP特异度有限（指南引用的3D MRCP研究特异度36%）；肝活检是最有支持价值的检查；术中胆道造影加残余胆管的组织学检查是金标准——中国2025年版指南写明为腹腔镜或开腹胆道探查。
teachingPoints.en: Making the diagnosis (NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017, recommendations 6–10): ultrasound may show an absent or abnormal gallbladder, suggestive but not diagnostic of atresia; scintigraphy and MRCP have limited specificity (36 % for 3D MRCP in the study cited); liver biopsy is the most supportive test; intraoperative cholangiography with histology of the duct remnant is the gold standard — laparoscopic or open exploration in the 2025 Chinese guideline.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: citrin缺陷（Inui等，亚太儿科胃肠肝病营养学会专家意见，2024；Okano等，2019；GeneReviews，2025年修订）：SLC25A13基因的常染色体隐性遗传病，小婴儿表现为胆汁淤积、高氨血症、高瓜氨酸血症和脂肪肝，由基因检测确诊；用无乳糖、富含MCT的配方奶和脂溶性维生素治疗，多数在1岁左右肝功能恢复，少数需肝移植。它不能按经典尿素循环障碍处理：GeneReviews把葡萄糖、甘油和果糖输注（有脑水肿风险）以及低蛋白、高碳水化合物饮食列为需要避免的情况，Okano等也指出应避免持续输注高浓度葡萄糖的静脉营养。
teachingPoints.en: Citrin deficiency (Inui et al., APPSPGHAN expert review 2024; Okano et al. 2019; GeneReviews, revised 2025): an autosomal recessive SLC25A13 disease presenting in young infants with cholestasis, hyperammonaemia, hypercitrullinaemia and fatty liver, confirmed by genetic testing; treated with a lactose-free, MCT-enriched formula and fat-soluble vitamins, most recovering liver function by about a year and a few needing a transplant. It is not managed like a classic urea-cycle disorder: GeneReviews lists glucose, glycerol and fructose infusions (risk of brain oedema) and low-protein, high-carbohydrate diets among what to avoid, and Okano et al. warn against continuous high-glucose intravenous feeding.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 维生素K（Konakion MM Paediatric说明书，2024年修订；NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017）：胆汁淤积的婴儿口服维生素K吸收不良，必须肌注或静脉注射；说明书治疗维生素K缺乏性出血首剂1 mg静脉注射，再按临床和凝血决定是否追加，本例对他延长的凝血时间采用这一静脉剂量。NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017指出，注射维生素K后仍不纠正、且与肝损伤不相称的严重凝血障碍，提示妊娠期同种免疫性肝病、代谢病或败血症。任何活检或手术前都要先纠正。
teachingPoints.en: Vitamin K (Konakion MM Paediatric SmPC, revised 2024; NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017): infants with cholestasis must have vitamin K by intramuscular or intravenous injection because oral absorption is impaired; the SmPC treats vitamin K deficiency bleeding with 1 mg IV first, further doses following the clinical picture and the clotting, and the case gives that IV dose for his prolonged clotting. NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN 2017 notes that a severe coagulopathy unresponsive to parenteral vitamin K and out of proportion to the liver injury may indicate gestational alloimmune liver disease, metabolic disease or sepsis. Correct it before any biopsy or operation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 一个诊断不等于全部答案（本报告，2013；国家卫健委2025年版）：中国2025年版指南把citrin缺陷列为需与胆道闭锁鉴别的疾病，本例说明两者也可以并存。能解释一部分表现的诊断，不应结束对其余表现的追查。
teachingPoints.en: One diagnosis is not the whole answer (this report, 2013; NHC 2025): the 2025 Chinese guideline lists citrin deficiency among the conditions to tell from biliary atresia, and this case shows that the two can also coexist. A diagnosis that explains part of the picture must not end the search for the rest.

unknowns.zh-CN: 生命体征，以及心脏、眼、面容、皮肤出血点等其他系统的查体；医护人员对大便颜色的观察。
unknowns.en: Vital signs and the rest of the examination (heart, eyes, facial features, any bruising or petechiae); any staff observation of his stools.

unknowns.zh-CN: 转氨酶、碱性磷酸酶、胆汁酸、血糖、血常规、甲状腺功能、先天感染筛查、他本人的乙肝标志物和新生儿筛查结果；所报数值的参考范围；首批化验的采血日期。
unknowns.en: Transaminases, alkaline phosphatase, bile acids, glucose, full blood count, thyroid function, the congenital infection screen, his own hepatitis B markers and his newborn screening; the reference intervals for the values reported; the day the first samples were taken.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出生时或住院期间是否注射过维生素K，之后的凝血复查结果，以及有无出血。
unknowns.en: Whether vitamin K was given at birth or during either admission, any clotting result after it, and whether he bled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 一个半月时住院用的是什么药、做过哪些检查；营养治疗的具体奶粉或方案、开始时间、复查的血氨数值，以及它与基因结果的先后。
unknowns.en: The medicines and tests of the admission at about six weeks; the feed or regimen of the nutritional treatment, when it started, the repeat ammonia value and its timing relative to the genetic result.

unknowns.zh-CN: 腹腔镜时的月龄、是否做了胆道造影、活检部位和纤维化分级方法。
unknowns.en: His age at the laparoscopy, whether a cholangiogram was done, the biopsy site and the fibrosis scoring used.

unknowns.zh-CN: 家属不接受Kasai手术的理由，之后的治疗（如肝移植评估）、长期肝功能、营养和生存结局；HBsAg阳性的后续核实（没有写明是谁的结果）。
unknowns.en: The family's reasons for not accepting a Kasai operation, his later treatment (such as transplant assessment) and his long-term liver, nutritional and survival outcomes; the follow-up of an HBsAg-positive result (whose is not stated).

unknowns.zh-CN: 父母是否近亲、母亲孕期情况和产前超声、过敏史。
unknowns.en: Whether the parents are related, the pregnancy and antenatal scans, and any allergies.
